column1: # Curated duplicates for `collgen.py dupes`: the community example (#190). A private checkout keeps its own list in
# personal/skills/collections/duplicates.tsv, which is the default there (nested.data_path). Tab separated:
# keep-system  keep-path  hide-system  hide-path   (paths as in the gamelist <path>)
# collgen.py dupes sets <hidden>true</hidden> on the hide entry; the keep entry must exist.
# "-  -" in the hide columns = keep-only note: fbneo contra stays visible next to NES Contra on purpose.
# Kept on purpose, NOT listed (different games, not ports): NES Bionic Commando, Ninja Gaiden, Rygar,
# Contra, Battletoads, Double Dragon II; SNES Super Punch-Out!!; Genesis Moonwalker; Neo Geo Double Dragon.
